title: Avellaneda–Stoikov Optimal Market Making
holding_period: seconds to minutes (continuous two-sided quoting; inventory mean-reverts to flat)
data_requirements: level-1 or level-2 limit order book data
individual fill records with quote distance, for calibrating A and k
high-frequency realised volatility estimate for sigma
queue position data for tight-tick markets

sources.citation: Avellaneda, M., & Stoikov, S. (2008). High-frequency trading in a limit order book. Quantitative Finance, 8(3), 217-224.
ragoragino/avellaneda-stoikov — third-party Python replication (not audited in-session).
Guéant, O., Lehalle, C.-A., & Fernandez-Tapia, J. (2011). Dealing with the inventory risk: a solution to the market making problem. (Adds inventory bounds and exact closed forms.)
Guilbaud, F., & Pham, H. (2011). Optimal high frequency trading with limit and market orders. arXiv:1106.5040. (Adds market orders and a discrete tick grid.)
